severin.desc: Abbot Severin (mini-boss, 3x, G5): hooded gold tabard over a wine tunic, belted, gold mask, mace of light. No plate.

storm_sentinel_gate.desc: Storm sentinel, gate foe (2x): the same lightning golem, bigger.

fridleif_boss.desc: Captain Fridleif Thunderhelm (3x, conquer): leather jerkin + gilded tabard, spear and shield; yields at 25%. No plate.

centaurchamp.desc: Centaur champion (rare, 2.5x): white-maned centaur in a storm-blue belted tunic, lightning lance.

elderwraith.desc: Elder light wraith (rare, 3x): tall gold shroud with a cracked halo; drinks lamp light.
